summary: Aibotics, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing an October 12, 2026 Asset Sale and Purchase Agreement to acquire PlayJamaica Limited's robotics, drone-services, AI and mapping assets, including the NovaCore Labs branding, NovaCore Nexus software and novacorelabs.com domain, while PlayJamaica retains VR, simulator, creative, event and esports businesses. Consideration is 22,500 Series B Preferred shares with $225,000 stated value plus up to $3,000,000 in earn-out stock across four $750,000 revenue tranches; roughly $35,000 of liabilities are assumed. Gregory Moore becomes Subsidiary President; $1,000,000 Reg A-funded budget is contemplated, with a repurchase right if unfunded. Watch earn-out attainment and financing execution.
